parsed.explanation: The function `lookup` constructs an SQL query dynamically using user-provided input (`username`). This allows an attacker to inject malicious SQL code into the `username` parameter, potentially bypassing access controls and retrieving unauthorized data. The use of single quotes (`'`) around the `username` value is not sufficient to prevent SQL injection because it only protects against literal single quotes, not other special characters that could be part of an SQL command.
